title: What's New: IRS1099 Integration with IRIS (2025 release wave 2)

chapters.title: How the integration works - electronic filing
Demo - setting up and creating 1099 forms
Demo - sending to IRS and tracking status
Demo - correcting 1099 forms after IRS acceptance

features.name: 1099 electronic filing to IRS
features.description: Direct application-to-application integration with the IRS portal allowing cloud users to submit 1099 forms electronically without printing or manual submission.
caveats: Only for cloud users for full A2A integration
On-premise users must create files and manually upload to IRIS portal

features.name: 1099 form documents
features.description: Create and manage 1099 form documents in Business Central with automatic calculation of total payment amounts for each vendor.

features.name: IRS transmission creation and sending
features.description: Combine multiple released 1099 form documents into a single transmission, automatically validate data, generate XML, and send directly to the IRS portal.

features.name: 1099 correction workflow
features.description: Allow documents to be reopened and corrected after IRS acceptance, mark corrected lines, and send replacement transmissions with only the corrected amounts.
caveats: Must use allow correction action before reopening document

features.name: 1099 substitution forms
features.description: Create PDF 1099 substitution forms and send them to vendors via email or print hard copies and send by mail. Email transmission can be encrypted for security.
caveats: Requires vendor consent for email delivery

features.name: 1086 form deprecation
features.description: The 1086 form functionality is being deprecated because 1089 electronic submission eliminates the need for 1086 forms when deploying 1089 electronically.
features.status_evidence_quote: And the future for 1086 form, we will deprecate this functionality because you do not need 1089 1086 when you are uh deploying 1089

features.name: Transmission history and acknowledgement tracking
features.description: View transmission history showing when transmissions were sent, their type and status. Download and review IRS acknowledgement content in XML format to see statuses and errors.
